targets.rawSql: SELECT experiment_key, argMax(decision, computed_at) AS decision, argMax(control_n, computed_at) AS control_n, argMax(treatment_n, computed_at) AS treatment_n, round(argMax(srm_p_value, computed_at), 4) AS srm_p_value, round(argMax(lift, computed_at), 4) AS conversion_lift, round(argMax(p_value, computed_at), 4) AS conversion_p_value FROM ab.experiment_results WHERE metric_key = 'conversion' GROUP BY experiment_key ORDER BY experiment_key

SELECT experiment_key, metric_key, argMax(role, computed_at) AS role, round(argMax(control_mean, computed_at), 4) AS control_mean, round(argMax(treatment_mean, computed_at), 4) AS treatment_mean, round(argMax(lift, computed_at), 4) AS lift, round(argMax(ci_low, computed_at), 4) AS ci_low, round(argMax(ci_high, computed_at), 4) AS ci_high, round(argMax(p_value, computed_at), 4) AS p_value, round(argMax(cuped_lift, computed_at), 4) AS cuped_lift, round(argMax(cuped_p_value, computed_at), 4) AS cuped_p_value FROM ab.experiment_results GROUP BY experiment_key, metric_key ORDER BY experiment_key, metric_key
SELECT toStartOfDay(exposed_at) AS time, variant_key, avg(converted) AS value FROM ab.user_level WHERE experiment_key = 'checkout_cta' GROUP BY time, variant_key ORDER BY time
SELECT experiment_key, variant_key, round(avg(refunded), 4) AS refund_rate, count() AS users FROM ab.user_level GROUP BY experiment_key, variant_key ORDER BY experiment_key, variant_key
